author: Takeaway
description: Rice paddies and recently cleared forest land in Amphoe Mae Chaem, along road 1263 between the town of Khun Yuam (Mae Hong Son province) and the town of Mae Chaem (Chiang Mai province), on the west flank of Doi Inthanon (the highest mountain of Thailand) during the hot and dry season of 2010.
